note: MAPPING (paper_order, where the 'order' is Carver's canonical 1-28 numbering, not the paper's -- the paper names the Brief COPE and its 14 subscales but prints no items): the IRW codes BC1..BC28 ARE the S1 column names (data/graves_2021_stress_coping.py melts [f'BC{n}' for n in range(1,29)] with var_name='item'; no rename, no positional step), and the S1 CSV carries no labels or codebook, so BCn -> Carver item n is an inference from the numbering. Step 5b route 3 (verify_graves_2021_brief_cope.R, PASS): each of the authors' 14 stored subscale scores in S1 is reproduced exactly, over 977-985 complete rows, by one and only one of the 378 possible BC pairs, and that pair is Carver's key every time (Self_Distraction {1,19}, Active_Coping {2,7}, Denial {3,8}, Substance_Use {4,11}, Emotional_Support {5,15}, Instru_Support {10,23}, Behavioral_Disengage {6,16}, Venting {9,21}, Pos_Reframe {12,17}, Planning {14,25}, Humor {18,28}, Acceptance {20,24}, Religion {22,27}, Self_Blame {13,26}); live per-item means and n equal the S1 columns' exactly for all 28 (max |diff| 0). NOT established: order within each 2-item pair (e.g. BC1 vs BC19) -- a within-pair swap reproduces every composite, so status PARTIAL. TEXT (canonical_instrument): all 28 item stems and the four anchors verbatim from Carver's page, including its stray period in item 3 ('I've been saying to myself "this isn't real.".'), kept as printed. The study's administered form is unpublished; its paper describes the scale only as 'rated on a scale of 1-4, 1 indicated "doesn't do at all", to 4 "does a lot"', consistent in direction with Carver's 1='I haven't been doing this at all' .. 4='I've been doing this a lot' (resp = Carver's own numeric codes; live resp set 1-4, every item uses all four levels). instructions left BLANK deliberately: Carver's printed instructions are for a presurgery interview ('since you found out you were going to have to have this operation') and he invites adapting them, so they are not what these students read, and the study's own instructions are not published. English administration (Florida Atlantic University), so no language/_translated columns. RIGHTS: Carver's page (the originator's) states 'You are welcome to use all scales of the Brief COPE, or to choose selected scales for use. Feel free as well to adapt the language for whatever time scale you are interested in.' -- no fee, permission, NC, ND or redistribution clause; silence is permission, consistent with menaldi_2023_brief_cope (batch_105) and koirala_2024_brief_cope (batch_063). instrument_rights_register.csv has NO Brief COPE row; this is ship-shaped, so per the 2026-09-10 rule no row was written -- escalated for Ben to register.
